2000.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.

2001.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Stability control
The stability / traction warning light should stay off on the drive.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
